meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 这个技能会安装 OneCLI 并设置 Agent Vault,把 .env 文件中的 Anthropic 等凭据迁移进保险库,删除原密钥匙,随后重建并重启服务,最后确认网关配置已生效。
howto.when: 当 /update-nanoclaw 把 OneCLI 作为破坏性变更引入后,或首次搭建 OneCLI 时触发。

say.text: 帮我初始化 OneCLI,迁移 .env 里的凭据。
say.note: 安装并配置 OneCLI,把密钥搬进保险库。

say.text: 我更新了 NanoClaw,帮我配置 OneCLI。
say.note: 会检查现有配置,然后安装和迁移。

say.text: 把 OPENAI_API_KEY 也迁到 OneCLI 保险库。
say.note: 会先征求你的确认,再迁移该凭据。

howto.what_en: Installs OneCLI and sets up Agent Vault. Migrates credentials from .env into the vault, removes raw keys, rebuilds and restarts the service, and verifies the gateway config.
howto.when_en: Use after /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

say_en.text: Initialize OneCLI and migrate my .env credentials.
say_en.note: Installs OneCLI and moves secrets into the vault.

say_en.text: I updated NanoClaw, please set up OneCLI.
say_en.note: Checks existing config, then installs and migrates.

say_en.text: Migrate OPENAI_API_KEY to OneCLI vault too.
say_en.note: Asks for confirmation before moving that credential.
